summary: Flow step 1 allows unlimited clarifying questions, so users with vague ideas may never reach a brief.

findings.quote: 1. Read the idea. Ask clarifying questions whenever anything is unclear, and keep asking until every detail is settled.
findings.trigger: A user with a vague idea answers each question briefly.
findings.expected: At most three questions, then a brief.
findings.actual: Questions continue until every detail is settled.
findings.impact: Conversation fatigue and abandonment before any brief is produced.
findings.fix: Cap blocking questions at three and proceed with stated assumptions.
findings.evidence_detail: The instruction has no upper bound or exit condition.

non_findings: The five headings are plain-language and ordered from goal to action.
The out-of-scope reply offers a useful next step (EV10).
